preconditions.description: Both rows and columns must be integers.
Both rows and columns must be positive integers.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == rows and all(len(row) == columns for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: The returned array must have the specified number of rows and columns.
The first element of each row must be 'O'.

postconditions.expression: all((row[i] == 'O' if (i + j) % 2 == 0 else row[i] == 'X') for j, row in enumerate(return_value) for i in range(columns))
postconditions.description: Each element in the array must alternate between 'O' and 'X' based on its position.
